description: Track earthquakes and volcanoes in New Zealand from a workflow, with data from GeoNet. List the quakes that may have been felt, look one up with its location history, search the whole catalogue by time, magnitude, depth and place, and count quakes by week, month and year. See what people felt and what sensors measured, and the strong-motion readings for a quake. Check every volcano's alert level and the quakes beneath it, read GeoNet's bulletins, and look up its monitoring stations. Start a workflow when a new quake strikes or a volcano's alert level changes. No account or API key required.
